title: Count Character
description: Write a function that counts how many times a specific character appears in a string. For example, in 'banana' the character 'a' appears 3 times.
instructions: Complete the count_char function so it returns how many times the given character appears in the string.
hints: Loop through each character in the string.
Compare each character to the target character using ==
Keep a counter and increment it each time you find a match.
